title: Zombies vs Plants — Card Research

groups.label: Plants
groups.description: Broad Plant research for the shared pool. Overgrowth is confirmed green for the first Jumpstart box, with early plays to support its partners.

groups.label: Treefolk
groups.description: Ancient Grove is confirmed white: stompy Treefolk, nature spirits, and actual bird allies. Preferred early birds are Healer's Hawk, Rustwing Falcon, and Suntail Hawk, preserving singleton variety. Test the combined curve with each Plant partner; retain other colors for the cube.

groups.label: Fungi
groups.description: Spore Swarm is confirmed black: early Fungi, death value, and token support that work without green mana. Retain other colors and more elaborate engines for the shared cube research.

groups.label: Botanical allies
groups.description: Botanical Elementals and other discoveries to investigate across the shortlist. Group tags describe themes; explicit faction alignment takes precedence.

groups.label: Living lands
groups.description: Animated forests and swamps and their support. Wild Awakening is confirmed green, with simple land-animation effects and early plays; complex and off-color discoveries remain for the cube.

groups.label: Black · Necromancy
groups.description: Black necromancy, sacrifice, and recurring Zombies for the proposed Restless Dead packet.

groups.label: Blue · Stitched creations
groups.description: Blue stitched Zombies, graveyard setup, and strange experiments for the proposed Stitched Together packet.

groups.label: White · Mummies
groups.description: White mummies, coordinated creatures, embalming, and protection for the proposed Tomb Guard packet.

groups.label: Green · The Turned
groups.description: The Turned targets simple green-paid Zombies, prioritizing turned plant life where practical. Black-green and three-color candidates remain visible as shared research for the cube.

groups.label: Mana support
groups.description: Flexible lands and fixing for combined Jumpstart decks and the wider multicolor cube research.

retentionPolicy: Retain every candidate and its source notes for Jumpstart rebalancing and a future cube, including cards omitted from any draft. Versioned packet selections and replacement reasons must not delete unused research.
